# Ralph Estep Jr.

> Ralph Estep Jr. is a Licensed Public Accountant (LPA), business coach, author, and podcaster based in Middletown, Delaware. He helps everyday people build real financial confidence — not just informed, but equipped. He runs the accounting practice Saggio Management Group and hosts four shows reaching 770,000+ YouTube subscribers.

Key facts:
- Credential: Licensed Public Accountant (LPA) — 30+ years in practice
- Accounting practice: Saggio Management Group, 1100 Dutch Neck Road, Middletown, Delaware (https://saggioaccounting.com)
- Approach: empathy-first, no-shame personal finance; faith-informed but not faith-exclusive
- Serves: everyday people, families, small business owners, and content creators — locally in Delaware for accounting and tax, nationally/globally for coaching, speaking, and content

- [Coaching](https://www.ralphestepjr.com/coaching): One-on-one financial coaching and accountability

- [Book an appointment](https://www.ralphestepjr.com/schedule): Tax preparation, discovery calls, monthly client check-ins, and QuickBooks/payroll support
- [Contact](https://www.ralphestepjr.com/contact): Coaching, speaking, accounting, and press inquiries
- [Press & media kit](https://www.ralphestepjr.com/press): Speaker bios, photos, and interview angles
